injects.title: Initial Earthquake Impact Report
injects.description: M7.4 earthquake struck at 06:30. Multiple reports of building collapses in Batagram City. Communication lines partially disrupted. District administration requesting immediate federal assistance.

injects.title: Aftershock M5.8
injects.description: A magnitude 5.8 aftershock has caused secondary collapses in Batagram City center. Rescue teams report additional casualties. Building safety becomes critical concern.

injects.title: KKH Road Blocked
injects.description: Karakoram Highway blocked at 3 points due to landslides between Mansehra and Batagram. No road access to district. Air support requested.

injects.title: Power Grid Failure Confirmed
injects.description: Complete power grid failure across Batagram district confirmed by WAPDA. Emergency generators needed for hospital and NEOC operations.

injects.title: 200 Children Trapped in School
injects.description: Reports from local authorities: approximately 200 children trapped in collapsed Government Primary School in Batagram Tehsil. Urgent SAR deployment needed.

injects.title: Telecom Partially Restored
injects.description: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority reports 40% mobile network coverage restored in Batagram City area. Rural areas still in communication blackout.

injects.title: Cholera Cases in Displacement Camp
injects.description: Health workers report 15 suspected cholera cases in the largest displacement camp near Batagram City. Water supply contaminated by landslide debris.

injects.title: International SAR Teams at Islamabad
injects.description: Three international Urban SAR teams (Turkey, UAE, China) have arrived at Islamabad airport. Transport to Batagram needed. Coordination with DDMA required.

injects.title: Winter Storm Warning
injects.description: PMD issues severe weather warning: heavy snowfall expected in Batagram above 2000m within 48 hours. 30,000 displaced persons in makeshift shelters at risk of hypothermia.

injects.title: Tarbela Dam Monitoring Alert
injects.description: Tarbela Dam monitoring station reports minor seepage increase following continued aftershocks. WAPDA engineers dispatched for assessment. Downstream communities placed on alert.

injects.title: GBV Incident Reports
injects.description: GCC protection monitors report 5 GBV incidents in displacement camps. Women-friendly spaces insufficient. Urgent need for female protection officers.

injects.title: Shelter Gap Analysis
injects.description: 50,000 winterized tents distributed, but 30,000 families still without adequate shelter. Provincial government requests additional federal support for transitional shelters.

injects.title: School Resumption Planning
injects.description: Education department requests temporary learning centers for 45,000 affected students. 60% of school buildings damaged or destroyed. UNICEF offers support.

injects.title: Compensation Disbursement Issues
injects.description: Affected families complain of delays in compensation payments. Biometric verification system not functional in remote areas. Political pressure mounting.

injects.title: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
injects.description: PM Office requests comprehensive reconstruction cost estimate for Batagram. Preliminary assessment indicates PKR 85 billion needed for infrastructure and housing.

injects.title: Lessons Learned Workshop
injects.description: Chairman NDMA directs NIDM to organize comprehensive lessons learned workshop. All wings to submit after-action reports within 2 weeks.

injects.title: Build Back Better Framework
injects.description: International donors (World Bank, ADB) offer USD 500M for reconstruction. Require earthquake-resistant building codes compliance for all funded projects.
